{{Top|leg}}
'''Crystal of the Stars''' was a sculpture created by the [[Balinaka]] [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]] [[Vornest Dep-thesel Digarsarg]]. It was the first [[Garnib crystal]], created when Digarsarg incorporated colored [[pumice]] and gemstone fragments into his work, and noticed the beautiful, hypnotic light that was the result of sunlight filtering through the gems and glass.
